description: Use this when the person attaches a photo of food they ate or will eat. Returns estimated foods, grams, calories and macros for a plate, nutrition per 100 g for a packet, or grams for a kitchen scale. Processing uses one read from their daily food-photo allowance. Review the estimates and corrections with them before logging separately with log_foods or Log it on the card. Do not use for a photo that isn't food, or to judge anyone's body.

note.description: Anything they said about it ("half the rice", "oat flat white").

download_url.description: Where to fetch the photo; the app fills it in.

file_id.description: The app's id for the photo.

mime_type.description: The photo's type, such as image/jpeg.

name: read_meal_photo
title: Read a meal photo
